title: Government Bond Yields
description: Government benchmark yields, in percent: the US Treasury par yield curve and the ECB's euro area yield curves. Choose a curve and the provider to read it from.

list.name: curve
list.label: Curve
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT metadata->>'curve' FROM instrument
 WHERE asset_type = 'government_bond_yield' ORDER BY 1
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT metadata->>'curve' FROM instrument

list.name: source
list.label: Provider
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM v_latest_observation
 WHERE asset_type = 'government_bond_yield'
   AND instrument_metadata->>'curve' = ${curve:sqlstring}
 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Yield curve
panels.description: Latest yield by maturity, from the chosen provider.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT instrument_metadata->>'maturity' AS "Maturity",
       value AS "Yield"
  FROM v_latest_observation
 WHERE asset_type = 'government_bond_yield' AND observation_type = 'yield' AND instrument_metadata->>'curve' = ${curve:sqlstring} AND provider = ${source:sqlstring}
 ORDER BY CASE right(instrument_metadata->>'maturity', 1) WHEN 'M' THEN left(instrument_metadata->>'maturity', -1)::int ELSE left(instrument_metadata->>'maturity', -1)::int * 12 END

SELECT symbol AS "Symbol",
       instrument_name AS "Name",
       provider AS "Provider",
       value AS "Yield",
       coalesce(currency, unit) AS "Unit",
       quote_kind AS "Kind",
       freshness AS "Freshness",
       observed_at AS "Observed",
       age_seconds AS "Age"
  FROM v_latest_observation
 WHERE asset_type = 'government_bond_yield' AND observation_type = 'yield' AND instrument_metadata->>'curve' = ${curve:sqlstring}
 ORDER BY symbol, provider

SELECT observed_at AS "time",
       symbol || ' · ' || provider AS metric,
       value
  FROM v_observation
 WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
   AND asset_type = 'government_bond_yield' AND observation_type = 'yield' AND instrument_metadata->>'curve' = ${curve:sqlstring} AND provider = ${source:sqlstring}
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Data freshness
panels.description: Yields are published each business day, after the close.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT provider AS "Provider",
       asset_type || ' ' || observation_type AS "Data",
       series AS "Series",
       last_observed_at AS "Latest value at",
       last_ingested_at AS "Collected at",
       age_seconds AS "Age"
  FROM v_data_freshness
 WHERE asset_type = 'government_bond_yield'
 ORDER BY provider, asset_type, observation_type
